caption: Illustrative computational model. Signal-field contours are shown within model tissue only; nonzero field values in the surrounding medium are omitted, not zero. Vector contours interpolate the same 96 x 144 grid and add no simulation resolution.

source.description: Default condition computed by the unchanged shipped public MorphBrain demo on page load; exported without changing controls.

source_dimensions.full_domain_shown: Full 96 x 144 spatial extent; scalar-field content is explicitly clipped to tissue. Classification is masked to tissue.

field_display.type: interpolated filled contours plus contour lines, clipped to exact tissue cells
field_display.normalization: none; no auto or log normalization
field_display.sources: exact source-mask cells; no enlarged markers
field_display.scope: Within model tissue only; outside-medium values are nonzero and intentionally hidden by the tissue clip, not set to zero.
field_display.outside_field_treatment: display masking only; underlying exported arrays are unchanged

category_display.type: exact row-run SVG cell paths; no smoothing or contour interpolation

generator.metadata_timestamps: Only original source export timestamp; no runtime timestamp.
generator.typography_correction: The initial shell pipeline converted the multiplication glyph into a question mark; SVG now uses the ASCII numeric entity ×. All main-plate geometry and colours are unchanged.

morphbrain-field.svg.geometry: same path strings as main plate; no text outside panel

morphbrain-regions.svg.geometry: same path strings as main plate; no text outside panel

verification.reference_condition: The existing default condition was computed by the shipped demo on page load, then exported without changing controls.
